keyLimits.en: Standalone Arnold license for users without a Maya or 3ds Max subscription; ~$430/year equivalent per third-party trackers.
Pay-as-you-go token model for occasional use, tokens purchased in advance and consumed per use.

cautions.en: Arnold is included at no extra cost for users who already hold a Maya or 3ds Max subscription; the standalone price above only applies to Arnold-only licenses.
Exact current single-user monthly/annual price could not be confirmed on autodesk.com directly (page blocked); the $55/mo and $430/yr figures are third-party estimates and should be reverified.

capabilities.en: Advanced Monte Carlo ray-tracing (path-tracing) renderer built for production-quality, physically based rendering.
Scales for large production pipelines in film, TV, games and design visualization.
Plugs into major 3D applications: Maya, 3ds Max, Houdini, Cinema 4D, Katana, and Blender via community/third-party plugins.

limitations.en: No standalone free tier; a paid subscription (or bundled Maya/3ds Max license) or Flex tokens are required beyond any trial.
Physically based path-tracing is compute-intensive and typically requires capable CPU/GPU hardware for production-time renders.

reason.en: Direct competing production renderer used across the same DCC applications.
GPU-accelerated production renderer competing for the same VFX/animation studios.
Another GPU renderer targeting similar 3D content creation pipelines.
Physically based renderer overlapping with Arnold's use cases in architectural visualization and VFX.
